messages:
erin: Quick Q — deploying kustomize overlay for tenant-s3-uploader. We wire a SOPS-encrypted secret and a KSA with IRSA annotation, but the pod is looking for creds at /var/run/creds and our manifest mounts them at /var/run/secrets. No idea where the path diverged. Anyone seen this pattern?

raj: Can you paste the deployment volumeMount + env? Usually it's either the kustomize patch or an initContainer that moves files. Also check if the app reads from an env var like S3_CREDS_PATH.

erin: here's the kustomize patch snippet from the overlay:```yaml
patches:
- target:
    kind: Deployment
    name: tenant-s3-uploader
  patch: |
    - op: add
      path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/volumeMounts/-
      value:
        name: s3-creds
        mountPath: /var/run/secrets/s3
```

marta: our old helm chart mounted at /var/run/creds (legacy app), newer images expect /var/run/secrets/s3. Looks like overlay is correct, but base helm values might still be toggling a different mount via configmap. Also our SOPS CI step decrypts to kubernetes secret named tenant-s3-creds, ensure kustomize references that name.

leo: infra-bot just reported the canary failed during apply with: `MountVolume.MountPathNotFound` for /var/run/creds — suggests the current kustomize build still includes the old mount somewhere. Grep the rendered manifest: `kustomize build overlays/tenant | grep -n "var/run/creds"`

erin: ran the grep, found it in overlays/tenant/patches/legacy-init.yaml (we added that during a fast rollback). Probably missed removing it. Should we remove the init that symlinks old path to new?

raj: Two options: remove the legacy init or add a tiny init that creates the legacy path and symlinks to new mount. Example init:```yaml
initContainers:
- name: create-legacy-path
  image: busybox
  command: ["/bin/sh","-c","mkdir -p /var/run/creds && ln -s /var/run/secrets/s3 /var/run/creds || true"]
  volumeMounts:
  - name: s3-creds
    mountPath: /var/run/secrets/s3
```

marta: we should avoid symlink hacks unless rolling out gradually. Also double-check the ServiceAccount: IRSA needs `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` annotation on the KSA and the pod must have automountServiceAccountToken: true for projected token volumes. I found in our tenant overlay we set `automountServiceAccountToken: false` historically.

erin: ohhh — that might explain why the pod can't access projected token path even if mount exists. Where do we set automount in our kustomize?

leo: it's in overlays/tenant/kustomize-common.yaml under `serviceAccount` patch. Patch currently:```yaml
- op: replace
  path: /serviceAccount/automountServiceAccountToken
  value: false
```

raj: change that to true. Also verify the IAM role annotation is on the ServiceAccount: `metadata.annotations.eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/tenant-s3-role`

marta: CI note — after toggling automount we need to bump the canary to avoid a full rollout. Add a canary percentage in the rollout config.

erin: plan: remove legacy-init symlink patch, set automountServiceAccountToken: true in overlay, confirm SA has role-arn, then run `kustomize build overlays/tenant | kubectl apply -f - --server-side` on staging. I'll open a PR shortly. :thumbsup:

leo: sg. ping me in PR for quick approve.

infra-bot: pipeline/tenant-kustomize/build #421 failed 2 minutes ago — now rerun queued after PR is opened.

erin: thanks all — will update once PR is up.
